units.source_text: 源氏公子作了许多画，把日常感想题在画上，倘若寄与紫姬，必将得到她的回信。

en.t: Prince Genji made many paintings and wrote his everyday thoughts on them; if he were to send them to Lady Murasaki, he would surely receive a reply from her.

units.source_text: 这些画中情思缠绵，见者无不感动。

en.t: The feelings woven through these paintings were so tender and lingering that everyone who saw them was moved.

units.source_text: 大约是两人灵犀相通，同心相应之故吧，紫姬于寂寞无聊之时，也作了许多画，并将日常生活状况写在画上，集成一册日记。

en.t: perhaps because the two of them understood each other perfectly and their hearts answered one another, Lady Murasaki, when she was lonely and bored, also made many paintings, wrote the details of her daily life on them, and gathered them into a diary.

units.source_text: 想象这两种书画，定然非常富有意趣吧。

en.t: Imagining these two kinds of painted writings, they must surely have been full of charm and interest.
